messages.text: I’ve proposed a refund of **BRL 209.99** for the returned record player. The refund is limited to the amount paid for the unit; extra compensation cannot be added (refund-policy/v2/amount). Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card—replying “yes” here won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
The customer confirmed request prop-979a2e881f5c4245 and a staff member approved it, so it is ready to be paid.
